about.title: Ejaz Clinic & Advanced Surgical Hospital, Patna
paragraphs: At Ejaz Clinic, our main goal is to bring advanced medical and surgical care to all our patients. Our team of very competent and compassionate doctors dedicate their expertise in diagnosing and treating patients ailments.

We utterly understand the financial burden of healthcare and strive to make the care as affordable as feasible. We can proudly yet humbly proclaim that at Ejaz Clinic, no patient has ever been refused care due to their inability to pay for their treatment.

Dr. Ejaz Ali founded the hospital with this philosophy and built the deep foundations of this mission. Dr Shahzad, after finishing his surgical training from Mayo Clinic, took the baton in 2017. A team of expert doctors and healthcare providers was built to advance the complexity of care offered at our centre. Our team continues to grow and the variety of diseases now being treated has grown exponentially.
We look forward to taking care of patients in the most compassionate way feasible.

featured.title: Different paths, same calling: Ejaz Hospital welcomes newest medical students & fellows
featured.excerpt: Nearly 175 incoming medical students and fellows donned white coats at the annual White Coat Ceremony this summer to mark the start of their medical education and advanced surgical training.
featured.author: Dr. Shahzad Ejaz, Chief of Surgery
featured.fullContent:
The annual White Coat Ceremony at Ejaz Hospital represents a milestone of dedication, ethical healthcare, and compassionate service. Welcoming incoming surgical fellows, resident doctors, and clinical researchers, the event highlights the multidisciplinary spirit inspired by international medical excellence.

Addressing the newly inducted fellows, senior leadership emphasized the hospital's founding ethos: providing high-standard surgical precision and ethical medical care accessible to every patient regardless of socioeconomic status. Incoming fellows will train in modular surgical suites, advanced laparoscopic keyhole procedures, interventional radiology, and acute critical care units over their intensive residency.

articles.title: Take precautions and monitor for heat-related illness as temperatures soar again
articles.excerpt: High environmental temperatures increase the risk of heat exhaustion, heat stroke, and dehydration, especially for children and older adults.
articles.fullContent:
With regional summer temperatures reaching peak levels, clinical specialists at Ejaz Hospital advise proactive hydration, avoidance of direct mid-day sun exposure, and vigilance for warning signs of heat stress.

Heat exhaustion can quickly escalate to life-threatening heat stroke if internal body temperature regulation fails. Symptoms including dizziness, rapid pulse, profuse sweating followed by dry hot skin, confusion, and nausea demand immediate shaded rest, cooling hydration, and urgent medical evaluation at our 24/7 Emergency unit if symptoms persist beyond 30 minutes.

articles.title: Slipping rib syndrome causes pain as rib becomes unstabilized
articles.excerpt: Hypermobility in the false or floating ribs can lead to sharp intercostal nerve irritation and severe lower chest pain often misdiagnosed as visceral illness.
articles.fullContent:
Slipping rib syndrome occurs when costal cartilage attached to lower false ribs (8th, 9th, or 10th) detaches or stretches, causing the rib to rub against adjacent nerves with chest expansion or twisting movement.

Patients often endure prolonged unexplained chest or upper abdominal discomfort before receiving accurate dynamic ultrasound diagnostics. At Ejaz Hospital, multidisciplinary pain specialists and thoracic surgeons offer minimally invasive cartilage stabilization, intercostal nerve blocks, and targeted physical rehabilitation.

articles.title: How to cultivate optimism
articles.excerpt: Evidence-based psychological resilience and emotional wellness practices that strengthen immune response and post-operative surgical recovery.
articles.fullContent:
Clinical health research consistently links optimistic mental perspectives with improved cardiovascular health, balanced immune regulation, and faster recovery following major surgical procedures.

Cultivating optimism is a learnable skill that involves reframing daily cognitive appraisals, practicing gratitude journaling, and fostering supportive community relationships. Our patient recovery teams emphasize holistic health — addressing psychological well-being alongside physical healing for comprehensive long-term vitality.

articles.title: How confidence — and physical strength — keep you safe from falling
articles.excerpt: Core balance conditioning, environmental safety audits, and bone health vigilance help seniors maintain active mobility and prevent fractures.
articles.fullContent:
Accidental falls among older adults represent a leading cause of hip fractures, head trauma, and loss of independent living. Maintaining physical lower-extremity strength and balance confidence dramatically reduces fall frequency.

Ejaz Hospital's Physiotherapy and Orthopaedic teams recommend targeted daily quad strengthening, gentle heel-to-toe walking exercises, home trip-hazard modifications, and routine bone mineral density screenings to safeguard lifelong independence.
